name: Speedcubes Cape Town 2022

venue.name: Sea Point High School
venue.address: Main Rd, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8005

information:
Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached.

Entry fee for the competition with be R200.00. Please pay online at Speedcubes using the following URL: https://www.speedcubes.co.za/19-competitions. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! Please email Proof of Payment to maverickpearson@gmail.com, and include in the email the FULL NAME of the competitor that the entry ticket was purchased for.

Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly.

We will be releasing a Judging, Running and Scrambling video and potentially hosting an in-person tutorial before the competition date in order to familiarise both competitors and spectators who wish to volunteer with running the competition. We will be requiring everyone who wishes to judge or scramble to watch the video and attend the tutorial, especially if you are less than 12 years old or are a new competitor. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly.

Due to the school hall's capacity, we are limiting each competitor to a maximum of 4 visitors/spectators, who can attend for free.

The organiser and sponsor for the event is Speedcubes.co.za and there will be a limited number of cubes for sale on the day.
